Less-than-truckload carrier Averitt said Thursday it has opened a 100,000-square-foot distribution and fulfillment facility in Jackson, Mississippi. The announcement follows other recent investments the carrier has made to its network.

The new warehouse is near central Mississippi’s major freight lanes of I-20 and I-55. The Mississippi Department of Transportation announced Tuesday a $400 million project to improve the roadways and bridges along these corridors. The plan also calls for rail upgrades.

Most national LTL carriers have nearby service centers and Averitt operates a 57-door LTL terminal next to the new facility.

Maersk Invests $100 Million in Massachusetts Fulfillment Hub - Supply Chain 24/7

## The new 617,000-square-foot Maersk fulfillment center will open in late August and create about 1,000 jobs

 

Source: Courtesy of Maersk

Maersk is investing $100 million in a new fulfillment center in Hopedale, Massachusetts, creating about 1,000 jobs and expanding Northeast delivery capacity.

 By 24/7 Staff July 16, 2026 

Maersk will open a new 617,000-square-foot fulfillment center in Hopedale, Massachusetts, later this summer, investing $100 million in the project and creating approximately 1,000 jobs.

The facility will become part of Maersk's North American contract logistics network and will work with a major e-commerce customer. At full capacity, the site is expected to process up to 330,000 units a day while expanding the company's fulfillment and delivery network across the Northeast.

The Hopedale facility marks one of Maersk's larger recent investments in U.S. logistics infrastructure as retailers and brands continue placing inventory closer to customers to speed deliveries.

# Forceget Fulfillment Cuts DTC Fulfillment Costs an Average 23%, Audits Show

August 10, 2026

Written By: EIN Presswire

The rate increase is not the biggest number on a DTC shipping invoice. Distance is. Forceget opens bicoastal DTC fulfillment in California and Pennsylvania.

MIAMI, FL, UNITED STATES, August 10, 2026 / EINPresswire.com/ — The rate increases direct-to-consumer brands paid this year are the smaller of the two numbers on their shipping invoices. The distance an order travels moves the number far more: a $45 order costs about $10.50 to deliver into Zone 2 and about $16.80 into Zone 7, roughly 60% more for the same package to the same kind of customer. Forceget Fulfillment, which operates bicoastal warehouses in Perris, California and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, has opened direct-to-consumer fulfillment built around that gap.
